SELECT c.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS holdout_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e WHERE e.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS exposures,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS distinct_members,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=c.campaign_id AND e.delivered) AS distinct_delivered
FROM dim_campaign c WHERE campaign_name ILIKE '%garden%' OR campaign_name ILIKE '%spring%'

calls.statement:
WITH e AS (
 SELECT x.*, m.member_id, m.marketing_consent, m.is_current FROM fact_campaign_exposure x LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=x.member_key WHERE x.campaign_id=19)
SELECT
 count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT exposure_id) AS dist_exp, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS dist_keys,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE member_id IS NULL) AS no_member,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) AS dist_members,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19)) AS in_holdout,
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE marketing_consent) AS consent_true,
 min(contact_ts_utc), max(contact_ts_utc),
 count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE contact_ts_utc < '2026-05-04' OR contact_ts_utc >= '2026-05-25') AS outside_window,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE contact_channel NOT IN ('email','sms')) AS other_channel
FROM e

calls.statement:
WITH cm AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
s AS (SELECT f.*, m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM cm))
SELECT count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rcpt_line, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS buyers,
 sum(net_amount) AS net_all, sum(gross_amount) AS gross_all,
 sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE staff_purchase_flag) AS net_staff,
 sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE channel_code='WB') AS net_web,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel_code='WB' AND receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='cancelled')) AS cancelled_lines,
 sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE channel_code='WB' AND receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='cancelled')) AS cancelled_net,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_amount<=0) AS nonpos,
 min(sale_ts_utc), max(sale_ts_utc)
FROM s

SELECT (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24') AS rpt_before,
 (SELECT sum(returns_net) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24') AS rpt_returns,

calls.statement:
WITH cm AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
s AS (SELECT f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
      WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM cm)),
r AS (SELECT r.refund_net, sl.staff_purchase_flag, m.member_id FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=r.member_key
      LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line sl ON sl.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
      WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24' AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM cm))
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM cm) AS contacted,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) AS sales_nostaff,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM s WHERE NOT staff_purchase_flag) AS buyers_nostaff,
 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s) AS sales_with_staff,
 (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM r WHERE NOT coalesce(staff_purchase_flag,false)) AS refunds_nostaff,
 (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM r) AS refunds_all,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE staff_purchase_flag IS NULL) AS orphan_returns

s AS (SELECT f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key
      WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM cm)),
r AS (SELECT r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=r.member_key JOIN fact_sales_line sl ON sl.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id

 (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s) - (SELECT coalesce(sum(refund_net),0) FROM r) AS net_spend_eur
